fullPassage: Over the last several decades, scholars have developed standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information for future generations. What has remained neglected for the most part, however, are the needs of people with disabilities. As a result, many of the otherwise most valuable digital resources are useless for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, as well as for people who are blind, have low vision, or have difficulty distinguishing particular colors. While professionals working in educational technology and commercial web design have made significant progress in meeting the needs of such users, some scholars creating digital projects all too often fail to take these needs into account. This situation would be much improved if more projects embraced the idea that we should always keep the largest possible audience in mind as we make design decisions, ensuring that our final product serves the needs of those with disabilities as well as those without.

✅ ④ embraced: 'if more projects embraced'에서 가정법 과거 과거동사 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② prioritized → neglected: 원문은 장애인의 필요가 '무시되어(neglected)' 왔다고 함. prioritized(우선시된)는 뒤의 '쓸모없다'는 내용과 모순
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 일치: 학자들이 디지털 정보 기준을 개발해 왔다
✅ ② prioritized → neglected: 원문은 'What has remained neglected'(무시되어 온 것). prioritized(우선시된)로 바뀌면 장애인 요구가 우선시됐다는 뜻이 되어, 자료가 그들에게 쓸모없다는 뒤 내용(As a result)과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 가치 있는 자료가 장애인에게 쓸모없다
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 전문가는 진전했지만 일부 학자는 요구를 고려 못 함
det.tip: remained neglected(무시) ↔ prioritized(우선시)는 As a result 이하와 모순

questions.passage: Over the last several decades, scholars have developed standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information for future generations. What has remained neglected for the most part, however, are the needs of people with disabilities. As a result, many of the otherwise most valuable digital resources are useless for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, as well as for people who are blind, have low vision, or have difficulty distinguishing particular colors. While professionals working in educational technology and commercial web design have made significant progress in meeting the needs of such users, some scholars creating digital projects all too often fail to take these needs into account. This situation would be much improved if more projects embraced the idea that we should always keep the largest possible audience in mind as we make design decisions, ensuring that our final product serves the needs of those with disabilities as well as those without.
questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 학자들이 지난 수십 년간 디지털 정보에 대해 개발해 온 것은 무엇인가? 본문에서 찾아 영어 1단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: standards(기준): 학자들이 디지털 정보에 대해 개발해 온 것
det.analysis: 본문 S1 'scholars have developed standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information'에서 학자들이 개발해 온 것은 'standards'(기준)이다.
det.tip: developed standards for how best to ... — 기준을 개발했다

What has remained neglected for the most part, however, are the needs of people with disabilities. questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 전문가들이 사용자의 요구를 충족시키는 데 이룬 것은 무엇인가? 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: significant progress(상당한 진전): 전문가들이 요구 충족에 이룬 것
det.analysis: 본문 S4 'professionals ... have made significant progress in meeting the needs of such users'에서 전문가들이 이룬 것은 'significant progress'(상당한 진전)이다.
det.tip: have made significant progress — 상당한 진전을 이루다

questions.passage: Over the last several decades, scholars have __________ (develop) standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 현재완료(have + 과거분사) developed
det.analysis: 'scholars have __________ standards'에서 조동사 have 뒤에 현재완료를 완성하는 과거분사가 필요. '지난 수십 년간 개발해 왔다'는 현재완료의 의미. develop → developed
det.tip: have + 과거분사 = 현재완료 (have developed)

questions.passage: Over the last several decades, scholars have developed standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information for future generations. What has remained neglected for the most part, however, are the needs of people with disabilities. As a result, many of the otherwise most valuable digital resources are useless for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, as well as for people who are blind, have low vision, or have difficulty distinguishing particular colors. While professionals working in educational technology and commercial web design have made significant progress in meeting the needs of such users, some scholars creating digital projects all too often fail to take these needs into account. This situation would be much improved if more projects embraced the idea that we should always keep the largest possible audience in mind as we make design decisions, ensuring that our final product serves the needs of those with disabilities as well as those without.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 디지털 정보 제작 시 장애인의 접근성을 고려해야 할 필요성을 설명
det.analysis:
✅ ① 장애인의 접근성을 고려해야 할 필요성: 글 전체가 장애인의 필요가 무시되어 온 문제와 모든 사용자를 고려한 설계의 필요성을 다루므로 주제로 적절 ←정답
❌ ② 보존 기술의 역사: 보존은 기준 개발의 일부 예시
❌ ③ 웹 디자인 최신 유행: 본문과 무관
❌ ④ 데이터 저장 방법: 저장 기술이 아닌 접근성이 핵심
det.tip: 제목 'Making Digital Resources Accessible' = 디지털 자료의 접근성 확보

ch: 디지털 정보를 제작할 때 장애인의 접근성을 고려해야 할 필요성
디지털 정보 보존 기술의 역사적 발전 과정
상업용 웹 디자인 분야의 최신 유행과 흐름
미래 세대를 위한 효율적인 데이터 저장 방법

questions.passage: Over the last several decades, scholars have developed standards for how best to create, organize, present, and preserve digital information for future generations. What has remained neglected for the most part, however, are the needs of people with disabilities. As a result, many of the otherwise most valuable digital resources are useless for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, as well as for people who are blind, have low vision, or have difficulty distinguishing particular colors. While professionals working in educational technology and commercial web design have made significant progress in meeting the needs of such users, some scholars creating digital projects all too often fail to take these needs into account. This situation would be much improved if more projects embraced the idea that we should always keep the largest possible audience in mind as we make design decisions, ensuring that our final product serves the needs of those with disabilities as well as those without.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 처음부터 모든 사용자를 고려해 설계하면 장애인도 디지털 자료를 사용할 수 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 이미 충분히 접근 가능: 본문 S3 많은 자료가 쓸모없다 — 반대
✅ ② 모든 사용자 고려 설계로 해결: 본문 S5 'keep the largest possible audience in mind ... serves the needs of those with disabilities'와 일치하는 핵심 메시지 ←정답
❌ ③ 학자는 신경 쓸 필요 없음: 본문은 학자들이 고려해야 한다고 함
❌ ④ 기준 개선 불필요: 본문은 접근성 개선이 필요하다고 함
det.tip: 요지 = 모든 사용자(장애인 포함)를 고려한 설계가 필요

ch: 디지털 자료는 이미 장애인에게 충분히 접근 가능하다.
처음부터 모든 사용자를 고려해 설계하면 장애인도 디지털 자료를 사용할 수 있다.
접근성은 전문가만의 책임이므로 학자는 신경 쓸 필요가 없다.
디지털 정보 기준은 더 이상 개선할 필요가 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

"이러한 요구를 고려하지 못하다"

[조건]
(1) account, fail, into, needs, take, these, to를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것 (take ~ into account 활용)

det.korean: fail to take these needs into account = 이러한 요구를 고려하지 못하다
det.analysis: 본문 S4 'all too often fail to take these needs into account'에서 발췌. 동사(fail) + to부정사(to take) + 목적어(these needs) + into account 구조. fail to + 동사원형 = ~하지 못하다, take ~ into account = ~을 고려하다. 7단어: fail / to / take / these / needs / into / account.
det.tip: take ~ into account = ~을 고려하다. fail to + 동사원형 = ~하지 못하다
